evals.prompt: I have a TypeScript monorepo at github.com/acme/platform with apps/api and apps/web. I want to set up a coding factory that takes goal issues, breaks them into features, builds them with worktree agents, reviews the code, and merges to main. The factory should live inside the repo under factories/platform/. Max 2 concurrent waves, 3 issues per wave. Use OpenRouter with gpt-5.3-codex. Generate the full factory structure: config, supervisor tick graph, goal run graph, work execute graph, work item execute graph, and role contract stubs.
evals.expected_output: Complete factory scaffold with valid DOT graphs, config JSON, directory structure, and role contracts covering supervisor, decomposer, coder, reviewer, and merger roles

assertions.text: Includes a factory.config.json with max_concurrent_waves=2 and max_issues_per_wave=3
Includes a supervisor_tick.dot graph with start/done nodes and diamond gates
Includes a goal_run.dot graph for goal decomposition pipeline
Includes a work_execute.dot or wave_execute.dot for batch execution
Includes a work_item_execute.dot for single work item pipeline
DOT graphs reference openrouter and gpt-5.3-codex in model_stylesheet
Includes role contract stubs for at least supervisor, coder, reviewer, and merger
Output follows factory layout: graphs/, skills/, ops/ directories
DOT graphs use correct Taxi handler types (tool, codergen, agent.worktree, fan_out.dynamic)
Work item execute graph includes a build-review-retry loop with bounded retries

evals.prompt: I'm building a research factory for my ML paper survey repo at github.com/lab/survey-2026. Instead of coding, the production line should be: question intake -> literature search -> paper analysis -> synthesis -> peer review -> publish to docs/. No git worktrees needed - the agents just write markdown files. The factory infra should live in a separate repo (github.com/lab/factory-infra) and file its own bugs there. Generate the factory with custom roles for Searcher, Analyzer, Synthesizer, and Peer Reviewer.
evals.expected_output: Research factory with custom roles replacing coder/reviewer, separate infra topology, markdown-output production line, valid DOT graphs adapted for research workflow

assertions.text: Config or docs show separate factory_repo vs target_repo topology
Includes custom role contracts for Searcher, Analyzer, Synthesizer, and Peer Reviewer
DOT graphs do NOT use agent.worktree handler type
Pipeline covers: intake -> search -> analysis -> synthesis -> peer review -> publish
Includes a supervisor tick graph adapted for research workflow
Includes a factory.config.json with reasonable defaults
Pipeline publishes to docs/ directory as specified
Factory bugs are routed to the infra repo, not the survey repo

evals.prompt: I already have a coding factory at factories/backend/ that works great. Now I need a second factory at factories/frontend/ for our React app repo. Both should share the same supervisor tick pattern and code review skill, but the frontend factory needs a different builder role (uses Vite + Playwright instead of Jest) and a visual regression judge. Show me how to structure this so the shared pieces are reusable and the divergent pieces are factory-specific.
evals.expected_output: Multi-factory structure with shared graphs/skills in a common location, factory-specific overrides for builder and judge roles, clear separation of shared vs divergent pieces

assertions.text: Identifies a shared location for reusable graphs and skills
Shows separate factories/backend/ and factories/frontend/ directories
Supervisor tick graph is shared or templated between both factories
Code review skill is in the shared location, referenced by both
Frontend factory has a custom builder role mentioning Vite and Playwright
Frontend factory includes a visual regression judge role
Explains how factory-specific overrides work
